mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_ANSWER A INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON U.SEQ = A.USER_SEQ WHERE A.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT ANSWER_SEQ as answerSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, USER_SEQ as userSeq, ITEM_SEQ as itemSeq, QUESTION_TYPE as questionType, QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL as questionTypeDetail, ANSWER as answer, OTHER_TEXT as otherText, FILE_PATH as filePath, REG_DATE as regDate FROM SURVEY_ANSWER WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} ORDER BY QUESTION_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY_ANSWER ( EVENT_SEQ, QUESTION_SEQ, USER_SEQ, ITEM_SEQ, QUESTION_TYPE, QUESTION_TYPE_DETAIL, ANSWER, OTHER_TEXT, FILE_PATH, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{eventSeq}, #{questionSeq}, #{userSeq}, #{itemSeq}, #{questionType}, #{questionTypeDetail}, #{answer}, #{otherText}, #{filePath}, NOW() )
